title: CELINE Owner Registry
description:
Schema for owners.yaml and owners.local.yaml — the CELINE-side owner registry. It resolves the ownership blocks in governance.yaml to canonical foaf:Agent metadata (dataset-api), to Keycloak organizations (celine-policies), and to Superset groups and roles (celine-superset).

Scope note: this describes the CELINE registry. The dataspace identity registry (ds) models a larger entity — a Gaia-X LegalParticipant and a verification lifecycle — and carries it in the same file shape. Its keys (status, verified_by, evidence_ref, collects_consent and the dataspace block) are defined here as optional properties, so a merged deployment registry validates strictly as one document; the identity registry stays their owner and checks their semantics (for example, verified requires verified_by) in its own models. celine.governance.OwnerEntry parses both shapes (unknown keys are ignored, so an IR record loads fine for URI resolution).

owners.description: List of owner entries. The id field is the lookup key matched against the name field in governance.yaml ownership blocks.

id.description: Short alias used as the lookup key. Must match the name field in governance.yaml ownership blocks. Prefer lowercase kebab-case (e.g. 'open-meteo', 'trentino-mobilita'); underscores are permitted because governance files in use already carry them (e.g. 'overture_maps') and the id must match the ownership name exactly.

type.description: Schema.org organization type CURIE. Emitted as the JSON-LD @type alongside foaf:Organization in DCAT-AP responses.

name.description: Human-readable display name used as foaf:name in DCAT-AP output.

role.description: The party's role with respect to the data, e.g. 'publisher', 'controller', 'processor'. Distinct from organization.role, which is the Keycloak organization role. Declared but not yet consumed by any tooling — left unconstrained until the vocabulary is settled.

did.description: did:web: URI for organizations operating a dataspace connector. Takes priority over url as the canonical @id once set.

url.description: Canonical homepage URI used as foaf:homepage in DCAT-AP output.

organization.description: Keycloak organization provisioning block. When present with create: true, celine-policies keycloak sync-orgs will provision a Keycloak organization for this owner.

create.description: When true, this owner is provisioned as a Keycloak organization by sync-orgs. Defaults to false (skipped).

role.description: The organization's platform role: what kind of party it is on the platform. Emitted as attributes.type on the Keycloak organization, which organization_match's org_type compares against, and issued as organizationType in the dataspace OrganizationCredential. Common values: 'rec' (Renewable Energy Community), 'dso' (Distribution System Operator), 'org' (generic organization). Not the owner's type (a schema.org class for DCAT metadata) and not the credential's roles (Provider/Consumer, the dataspace participant role).

attributes.description: Free-form key/value attributes set on the Keycloak organization alongside the role.

status.description: Dataspace identity registry: the owner's verification state. Owned by the identity registry, which enforces its transitions.

verified_by.description: Dataspace identity registry: who verified the owner. Required by the identity registry when status is verified.

evidence_ref.description: Dataspace identity registry: a reference to the evidence the verification rests on.

collects_consent.description: Dataspace identity registry: the owner collects data-sharing consent from its members.

dataspace.description: Dataspace identity registry: the organization's dataspace onboarding — legal identity, connector, legal-terms acceptance. Read by the identity registry's org commands; an owner without it does not operate in the dataspace.

did.description: The participant DID, when it differs per environment from the owner's top-level did.

roles.description: Dataspace participant roles (e.g. Provider, Consumer), issued as the credential's roles. Not organization.role.

accepted.description: The legal-terms acceptance, registered by an operator.

aliases.description: Alternative lookup keys that resolve to this owner. Used to map generic placeholder labels in open-source governance.yaml files (e.g. 'rec') to the real deployment-specific owner. Each alias must be unique across the registry.
